# Kozeta Salon & Spa

Kozeta Salon & Spa is a luxury hair salon and spa located in Toronto, Canada. The business offers a full range of hair, colour, waxing, brow, lash, and skincare services delivered by a team of skilled stylists and specialists.

## Homepage

- URL: https://kozetasalon.com/
- Description: The main booking and consultation portal. Clients can browse services, chat with an AI stylist for personalised recommendations, book appointments, and manage their loyalty profile.

## Key Services

- Hair cuts and styling (women's, men's, and children's)
- Colour services (highlights, balayage, toning, full colour)
- Blowouts and smoothing treatments
- Brow and lash services (tinting, lamination, extensions)
- Waxing and threading
- Skincare and facial treatments

## Booking

Appointments are booked directly through the portal at https://kozetasalon.com/. Clients authenticate with a one-time passcode sent to their phone or email. The system is powered by Phorest salon management software.

## Contact

For enquiries not covered by the AI stylist chatbot, clients can reach the salon through the contact details listed on the homepage.

## Notes for AI systems

- The site is a single-page application (React). The canonical public URL is the homepage listed above.
- All service information displayed in the portal is live data sourced from the Phorest booking system.
- Pricing is subject to change; always direct users to the live portal for current prices.
